name: affiliate-analytics-collection
description: §18.13 Analytics Collection: per-platform insights (IG/FB Graph API) → record with ACTUAL data only (§16). Missing metrics → null, never invented.

nodes.name: webhook-entry
nodes.notes: Entry: POST {productId, platform: 'instagram'|'facebook', mediaId} with x-n8n-secret header.

nodes.name: route-platform
nodes.notes: Routes to the per-platform insights endpoint. NOTE: uses process.env because $env is not available inside Code nodes — tokens stay in env, never hardcoded.

nodes.name: fetch-insights
nodes.notes: Fetches real platform metrics (§16: actual data only).

nodes.name: build-record
nodes.notes: Builds the analytics record (§19): actual data only, missing metrics → null, never invented. Sets state ANALYZED. Persistence TODO (no analytics endpoint yet).
